newsitem.title: JAPAN: Letter bomb explodes at Tokyo TV station, one hurt.
newsitem.headline: Letter bomb explodes at Tokyo TV station, one hurt.

text.p: One person was injured when a letter bomb went off at a Tokyo television station on Wednesday, a network spokesman said.

An envelope containing what appeared to be a videotape addressed to one of the network's regular women newscasters exploded at the Nippon Television Network Corp headquarters in central Tokyo, the spokesman said.
There was no claim of responsibility for the letter bomb.
Nippon Television is affiliated with Japan's biggest newspaper, the Yomiuri Shimbun.
In December 1994, a parcel bomb addressed to a popular young actress exploded at the same television station, injuring two people.
